# 2 bed apartment for sale

> No. 14 Clonuske Drive, Balbriggan is a spacious 2 bedroom top floor(2nd floor-with large Attic) apartment within minutes walk of the Castlemill Shopping centre and close to Balbriggan town centre. This spacious property is situated in a mature well settled estate just off Hamlet lane. The property has a livingroom, kitchen, Attic storage, 2 bedrooms and a bathroom.
